artifacts.summary: 8-phase plan: build scripts/move-modules.py (7 rewrite classes, dry-run), validate it against the measured census, add invariants B1/B2, then relocate FormalSystem/Boneyard to Boneyard in one atomic move+harness-rewiring commit, assert the C11 denominator, and accept ADR-010.

memory_candidates.content: When relocating a module subtree in a gated repository, the gate-pattern widening and the move itself are atomically coupled and must land in one commit. A gate regex that matches citations by their old path prefix (e.g. 'FormalSystem/...') silently drops those citations from scope the moment the prefix is stripped; widening the regex to admit the new bare prefix pre-move instead pulls not-yet-valid bare paths into scope, turning the gate red. Neither ordering is green, so the widening, the re-rooting of every scan root, and the move form one atomic batch. Two companion rules: (1) anchor every rewrite rule on the FULL old prefix, never the bare final token, since bare-token citations that were relative to the old parent often become correct repo-root paths after the move and must stay byte-identical; (2) after re-rooting a counting gate, assert its DENOMINATOR, not just its PASS -- a gate whose scan root moved but whose match regex did not will happily print PASS on a shrunken denominator.
